decisions.reason: The net price display plugin serves B2B shop clients with little upkeep, but it was not seen on the website in 2020–2021, which suggests waning prominence and possible platform-migration risk.
The ERP interface supports client lock-in and the multichannel strategy, so it is worth maintaining even with lower website visibility.
Two sibling tracking plugins were already withdrawn and this one has not been seen since 2018, but it still adds portal coverage at low cost, so it stays for now under close review.
Net price reporting complements the display plugin for B2B clients at minimal cost, though its absence from the website and overlap with A make consolidation plausible.
